audit.why: 48.69% over 1142 games — a losing lane, and the chart gives Ornn four of seven stages with the prose openly calling the late game lost. Honest.
Timings are right: your levels 1-2, the level-3 skill check, level 6 as a roam spike rather than a kill spike, and his Sunfire and Thornmail timing. Only the mechanics behind them needed fixing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the magma pillar to his W in four places, and says that when HE is 'brittle' his abilities hit harder.
audit.why: Both halves are wrong. The pillar belongs to Volcanic Rupture (Q) — Riot: 'sends out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.' Bellows Breath (W) is a forward breath of fire: 'Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.' So the page tells you to bait a pillar out of the wrong ability and to block a slow that comes from the other one. And Brittle is applied to YOU, not to him — the page has the debuff on the wrong champion entirely, which means the reader thinks a state that makes him more dangerous is a state he suffers.
audit.corrected: Pillar returned to Volcanic Rupture, Brittle correctly described as landing on you from Bellows Breath.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Charge is called a 'slow E knockup' with no mention of the condition that makes it a knockup at all.
audit.why: Riot: 'If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up.' Without terrain it is just a dash through you. And his own Volcanic Rupture pillar counts as terrain — that is the entire Ornn combo, pillar first then charge into it, and it is the only knockup he has before 6. It also matters directly to you: a knockup is hard CC and it cancels Aegis Assault, so the answer is to stand away from his pillar rather than to brace against it.
audit.corrected: The pillar-into-charge combo and the Aegis Assault cancel written into early and mid.

audit.why: Searing Charge is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s and it is the only knockup he owns pre-6, so those fourteen seconds are the window where he cannot interrupt anything you do. Volcanic Rupture is 9s down to 7s, Bellows Breath 12s down to 10s, Call of the Forge God 140s at rank 1.

At level 2 my W+Q all-in is genuinely scary because he can only answer with a slow E knockup. The catch is his W passive — once he's "brittle" his pillar and E hit harder, so don't dive face-first into his pillar; bait it with my E block first.
edits.after: Ornn has no dash and a weak level 1, so I own the opening: Shield Vault into a tapped Comet Spear, or hold-aim the spear for poke he cannot answer. At level 2 my all-in is genuinely scary. Read his kit properly though. Volcanic Rupture (Q) leaves the magma pillar; Bellows Breath (W) is the flame that makes ME Brittle, not him. And Searing Charge only knocks up when he hits terrain — including his own pillar. So stand off the pillar.

notes: TWO STRUCTURAL ERRORS. First, the magma pillar was attributed to Bellows Breath (W) in four places. It belongs to Volcanic Rupture (Q) — 'After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location' — while Bellows Breath is the forward flame that applies Brittle. The page therefore told the player to bait a pillar out of the wrong ability. Second, and worse, the page said that once ORNN is 'brittle' his abilities hit harder. Brittle is applied to the enemy by Bellows Breath; the debuff was on the wrong champion, so the reader believes a state that makes him more dangerous is a state he suffers from. BEST ADDITION: Searing Charge only knocks up 'if Ornn collides with terrain while charging', and his own Volcanic Rupture pillar is terrain. That pillar-then-charge sequence is the whole Ornn combo and the only knockup he has before 6, and the page described the knockup as unconditional. It connects directly to your kit — a knockup is hard CC and cancels Aegis Assault, so the answer is to stand off the pillar rather than brace into it. I did not write the _missing-interactions claim that Bellows Breath cancels your channel; Riot's text for it is a Brittle application, and the knockup I can substantiate is Searing Charge's.
